updatesReal.detailReal: Global Chat media now uses the existing global-chat/{uid}/ Storage path with a 40-file per-user cleanup threshold, deleting the oldest 15 before a new image/GIF upload and retrying once after a real quota-exceeded response.
Added cleanupOldImagesReal scheduled every 24 hours. It removes Global Chat media older than 7 days and then trims the remaining global-chat/ media to a maximum of 40 files.
Global Chat shows the authenticated user's real media count and actual stored MB for the existing chat-media folder. No fake 2 MB estimate is used.
Auto-cleanup follows the already deployed Firestore/Storage contract at global-chat/{uid}/ instead of introducing the unsupported globalChatUploads/ path.

Added Cloud Functions server moderation, callable text/reply/private sends, client text-write denial, role field protection, Storage image validation, and the globalChats chronological composite index with a safe client fallback.
Global Chat now supports direct Imgur image URLs through the 🔗 button. Images use the existing chat renderer and the external URL only; no Firebase Storage upload is used.
The real 📹 top-bar button now receives a direct onclick handler plus a click-delegation fallback, so the Videos modal opens reliably even if the top bar is re-rendered.

Production Cloud Functions now validate Global Chat, replies, and private text server-side. Direct client text creates/edits are denied by Firestore Rules; trusted callable functions write moderated text and server rate-limit state.

Global Chat and Home now use a real video modal instead of the missing videos.html/video.html route. Only verified YouTube sources or existing local MP4 files are playable; missing local files are never referenced.
May opt-in footer subscription para sa real Gmail at optional phone contact, saved only in the subscriber browser with explicit consent.
Prepared ang real EmailJS v4 browser integration for update emails. Sending activates only after the owner supplies the real public key and configures the service/template.
version.json is the single version/build source: v1.2.16 • build 2026-09-25_1216.
The update action now clears browser caches/service workers and loads the latest site files; it does not claim to download files.
Homepage keeps one primary TUBAL BOT only. The duplicate Tubal AI assistant is removed from the homepage.
About and Contact now route to separate pages/about.html and pages/contact.html.
Footer shows version, build, and real local-data counts without loading placeholders.
Search uses real browser journal/feed data plus the repository game catalog and routes game results to their real CTRLZONE pages.
Empty states remain real by default; optional demo content is explicitly labeled [DEMO] and loads only after a user action.
